tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$t/dest"
# 4 archives, keep 3 -> oldest must be deleted, newest kept
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do : > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; done
echo "rotate 4->keep3: $(bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep=3)"
echo "remaining: $(ls "$t/dest" | tr '\n' ' ')"
# keep validation and unknown option
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0; echo "keep0 rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "bogus rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
# verify: --name filter, BAD missing archive, help
printf 'x\n' > "$t/dest/other-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
(cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "other-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "other-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256")
echo "name filter: $(bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name other)"
printf 'deadbeef  ghost file.tar.gz\n' > "$t/dest/ghost.sha256"
rc=0; out=$(bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name ghost) || rc=$?
echo "missing: $out / rc=$rc"
bash verify.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Smoke-test rotate/verify flags, keep validation, filters
Remove smoke script and run final test suite
Delete the temporary smoke-test script I created
Move scratch smoke script out of repo to /tmp

result:
Done — all 10 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh`).

Changed: **rotate.sh** (off-by-one: surplus is now the first *total−keep* oldest entries, and exactly-N archives exits with nothing to rotate), **verify.sh** (sidecar line split at the first space run so file names may contain spaces; also sourced from lib), **lib/common.sh** (new: shared option parser `parse_common_options` + `resolve_dir`), **tests/run_tests.sh** (3 checks for the rotate bug, 1 for the space-name bug).

One note: my scratch file `.smoke.sh` is left in the repo root — the sandbox blocked deleting it; feel free to `rm .smoke.sh`.
